title: I get AI to review my videos
hook: I'm using AI to look at my competitors
summary: How to use AI to review your own videos (and learn from the creators you admire)
body: How to use AI to review your own videos (and learn from the creators you admire)
I was watching way more of other people's content than I was making my own. So I turned that into a system:

1. Give AI the creators you respect and ask what makes their videos work
2. Turn that into a checklist of hooks, pacing and style
3. Have AI review MY videos against it: "do this, stop doing that"
Comment REVIEW and I'll send you the prompt.
